title: Murder on the Airwaves
summary: A local DJ is found shot dead in his recording booth. The other workers were getting lunch and no one was in the studio when the gunshot took place.
method: The killer set up a prerecorded track that depicted a struggle and a gunshot. The DJ thought he was live and was oblivious to this. The killer pretended not to see the DJ and asked the other employee to call for help. She then shot the DJ and left through the window, reappearing outside amidst the search. She later relocked the window in the commotion. The gun was hid outside and later brought to her house where it was found in a search.
motive: The killer was in debt and saw a potential tens of thousands of dollars if the DJ died because his valuable reggae albums would be sold.
notes:
This is the first episode with Madeleine.
It doesn't make sense why this is the episode where internal affairs appears because in the very first episode, a DI was murdered and the sergeant was found to be the murderer. Also, DI Goodman had worked on a case with his aunt.
